data.name: detail
data.shape: EvaluationDetail — score, bias, chain, attributions, signals[] | none | unreadable
data.source: app.readEvaluation.execute — the public projection; ownerView/llmPartialReasoning are nulled by the platform and never rendered as placeholders

components.purpose: The bottom of the explorer stack: every signal one agent consulted on one candidate, and the chain the candidate then followed.
components.current_implementation: max-w-3xl centered column: score line, the conflict sentence as plain prose when signals disagreed, the chain card, attributions, the module-grouped scorecard, back link. The none branch says the platform lists this evaluation but publishes nothing further — not a failure.
constraints: None (the platform publishes no detail) and unreadable (the read failed) must never render alike.
No placeholder is rendered for owner-private telemetry — an empty reasoning slot would say the agent explained nothing when it was not published.

components.purpose: Gate → attempt → decision → execution → outcome, each stage the platform's own words, absent stages absent.
components.current_implementation: One tokened card; a stage the platform did not record is absent, not empty; the execution message renders whitespace-pre-wrap, unparsed.
constraints: A stage the platform did not record is absent, never rendered as an empty row.
The execution message is the platform's own words, unparsed.

components.purpose: What each contributing signal was worth to the aggregate score.
components.current_implementation: Plain list, signal name or id, attribution percent, own score.
constraints: Rendered only when the platform published attributions.

components.purpose: Every signal consulted, module by module — the untriggered ones are the point.
components.current_implementation: Module groups with fired-counts; each row a tokened left rail (border-border-default since the-rails-join-too), Fired/Did-not-fire stated in words, the platform's sentence, indicator values in secondary text.
constraints: Untriggered signals are never filtered — what an agent looked at and dismissed is as much its strategy as what fired.
Fired / did not fire is stated in words, never by colour alone.
The per-signal sentence is the platform's, unparaphrased.

components.current_implementation: Shared NotConnected component; treatment owned by DT-0006.

flows.name: Read a leader's read
steps: read what fired and what was dismissed

accessibility.notes: Unreadable carries role=alert. Fired state legible without colour. No client JS.
